# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow the repository-wide instructions in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and the
normative development policy in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

For product scope and release boundaries, use
[project-docs/ROADMAP.md](../project-docs/ROADMAP.md) and the relevant document
under `project-docs/release/`. Do not infer APIs, dependencies, privacy claims,
or merge exceptions from historical files.
